title: A darkened full-width background band may be enlarged to its kit minimum width within 1.5 times and through the gate
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A band with text or a template overlay takes a 1700 px photo for a 1920 px minimum, enlarged through the gate.
A band with neither, and every other frame, still refuse a photo narrower than the minimum.
A photo needing more than 1.5 times, or under the gate's 1600 real pixels, is still refused.

tests: a full-width background band the template darkens or that carries text may be enlarged to its minimum width, within 1.5 times and through the gate
an owner photo whose usable region is narrower than the frame minimum width is refused
